description: This file is a Perl module providing utility functions for Git::SVN, including path and URL canonicalization, checking for optional modules, and helper functions for error handling and path manipulation.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Displays a message and exits with a fatal error code.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks if the Compress::Zlib module is available, indicating if compression is supported.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a given filesystem path to a canonical form suitable for SVN operations.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL into a canonical form safe for SVN operations.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Joins multiple path components into a single path, ignoring empty components.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a path segment to a URL, ensuring proper slashes and escaping.
